issue.body:
i'm looking for a way where we store some global values and use them in multiple classes,

tornado has a similar on tornado.web.Application
https://www.tornadoweb.org/en/stable/guide/structure.html#the-application-object

it can store variables and methods in it, which can be accessible in the entire app, is there anything similar available in starlette.


thanks in advance for the help.
issue.title: Global configuration inside app
